causal_expectation.expectation: Ablating the smallest-heldout-variance orthogonal-sketch direction, mapped back through its declared raw-space basis vector, reduces projected vision-context effective rank beyond tolerance while random and off-target ablations do not.
causal_expectation.falsification_rule: If on-target ablation fails to move the projected effective rank beyond tolerance while collapse is claimed, the causal claim is falsified; if a random or off-target direction moves it equally, the localization claim is falsified.

controls.expected_behavior: healthy full-rank reference scores above both diagnostic thresholds in the declared projected representation
benign low-variance case does not trigger the projected collapse diagnosis
